reviews.title: Great upgrade for the dollar on older laptops
reviews.comment:
Excellent way to upgrade/refurb/repurpose old computers on the cheap. This is now 3rd 256GB SSD from this manufacturer and they've been great for the money. Updating to SSD has allowed me to keep 11+ year old computers usable in shop environments.
Speed is great. Great install on the older Lenovo units (E540/E550) to reduce lag and keep productive performance, functionality, and durability on Win 10 Pro utilizing modern diagnostic SW.
2.5in SATA direct plug and play. Storage is great GB/$$.
reviews.author: Ivar Jorgensen

reviews.title: Works awesome and easy to install!
reviews.comment: So i have a basic HP mini tower for my office computer. The old hard drive went out so i replaced it with this and wow! It's like a brand new computer. So much faster! Start up takes less than 60 seconds. Really easy to install. Great product. Let's see how long it lasts me now! I'll update in a year.
reviews.author: Anthony Ginnetti

reviews.title: Price and performance
reviews.comment: I bought 3 of these to upgrade my computers and a friends and to upgrade one computer to Windows 11. Shopping is always great at Amazon. The drives arrived next day. All the drives have been installed and performance, speed is fantastic. No issues to complete process of Windows 10 and 11 installations. These installs were on older Dell, Lenovo and HP. I will follow up if I ever have issues with these drives.
reviews.author: Hugh M.

reviews.title: Worked in my laptop now using in my nvr
reviews.comment: It worked and speed was good. Nothing mind blowing but what is expected from ssd. SATA 2.5 ssd was easy to install, just using connectors.
